response.sql: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), above_overall AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg_hgb, os.overall_avg_hgb FROM patient_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE pa.patient_avg_hgb > os.overall_avg_hgb), kept_stats AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb) as mean_kept_avg FROM above_overall), final_results AS (SELECT ao.ID, ao.patient_avg_hgb as patient_avg, ao.patient_avg_hgb - ao.overall_avg_hgb as above_overall_avg, ao.patient_avg_hgb - ks.mean_kept_avg as above_kept_mean FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN kept_stats ks) SELECT * FROM final_results ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
